grader: silos.nn_core per-row scaled MAE, paired by item_id

target.unit: scaled-MAE units: lower bound of the 95 % paired-bootstrap interval of the mean per-row difference (y minus x; positive = x better)

test_set_sha256: <sha256 of the shared test file in the AWS-generated data tree (manifest.json of silos.job_data)>

details.claim: the lower bound of the 95 % paired-bootstrap interval (clusters = seeds resampled) of the mean per-row score difference is above 0; the target IS that bound, replayed by check_unit from the item records with the spec in details.gain
details.population: simulated silos: three simulated operators on the in-process Maveric twin, run in one account; not partner data
